title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 116 ]

blocks.text: When riding on buses, trains, and other public transportation, speak in a quiet or normal conversational tone, and try to avoid extended phone conversations. Loud, animated conversations can annoy others. Keep your wireless ringer as low as practical to avoid disturbing others. Keep your phone close and easily accessible if you're expecting an important call. If you must take an important phone call but are in a(n) inappropriate surrounding, such as during lectures, and concerts, set the phone to vibrate mode and answer the phone only after leaving the room.

readingSentences.english: When riding on buses, trains, and other public transportation, speak in a quiet or normal conversational tone, and try to avoid extended phone conversations.
readingSentences.korean: 버스나 다른 대중 운송수단을 탈 경우, 조용히 그리고 정상적인 대화의 어조로 말하고, 또한 긴 전화 통화는 피하라.

readingSentences.english: Loud, animated conversations can annoy others.
readingSentences.korean: 큰 목소리로 활기차게 전화 통화를 하면 다른 사람들을 짜증나게 만들 수 있다.

readingSentences.english: Keep your wireless ringer as low as practical to avoid disturbing others.
readingSentences.korean: 당신의 무선 울림 장치를 남들을 혼란하게 만드는 일을 피할 수 있기에 실질적일 정도로 낮게 유지하라.

readingSentences.english: Keep your phone close and easily accessible if you're expecting an important call.
readingSentences.korean: 중요한 통화를 기대한다면, 당신의 전화를 가까이에 그리고 쉽게 접근할 수 있게 두라.

readingSentences.english: If you must take an important phone call but are in a(n) inappropriate surrounding, such as during lectures, and concerts, set the phone to vibrate mode and answer the phone only after leaving the room.
readingSentences.korean: 당신이 중요한 통화를 해야 하면서도 그러나 강의를 듣거나 및 콘서트 장에 가 있는 경우와 같이 부적당한 환경에 놓여 있다면, 전화를 진동 모드로 놓고 그 방을 떠난 후에 응답하라.
